design_condition: The school building is placed on the western edge and the compact multi-purpose hall on the bank, reinforcing the existing courtyard while creating a mineral schoolyard whose continuous hard surface fails to respond to the playground's topographical difference.

positive.statement: The well-founded analysis of the local development and the resulting site composition are particularly impressive.
The geometrically clearly defined courtyard space is considered to be of high quality.
The single-storey structure allows individual access to the classrooms.
The compact multi-purpose room is clearly designed.
The school building's architectural expression seems very appropriate for the location.

negative.statement: Some therapy rooms are trapped in the proposed arrangement.
The arrangement of the toilets directly at the classroom entrances should be reconsidered.
The foyer of the multi-purpose room is too small.
The schematic and mostly closed facade design of the building by the lake does not do the location justice.
The surrounding design, especially the schoolyard, appears schematic and too mineral.
The topographical height difference in the playground was not adequately taken into account.
The design has weaknesses in its architectural expression and operational aspects.
